verdict.rationale: Kimi documents its own agent capabilities. The Kimi Code CLI can 'autonomously complete development tasks', and the assistant has an agent mode with Agent clusters plus an 'Agent 任务' entry point, so delegating multi-step tasks to the product itself is supported. The evidence does not show these tasks running in the background or coming back as a deliverable for review; they appear conversational. The scheduled-tasks feature is a recurring schedule, not delegation of a one-off task, so it gets no credit. Missing for 10: documented background or asynchronous execution, a review/approval handoff when the task finishes, detail on agent-mode limits and workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review
